title: Effect of Subject-Based Banding on Social Mixing in Schools
what_it_is: Effect of Subject-Based Banding on Social Mixing in Schools

sections.label: Full SBB in secondary schools
sections.summary: Full SBB began with the 2024 Secondary 1 cohort, and pilot students interacted more with diverse peers in mixed form classes.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Education (Mr Shawn Huang Wei Zhong) (for the Minister for Education)
sentences.text: Full Subject-Based Banding (Full SBB) was implemented in secondary schools starting with the Secondary 1 cohort in 2024.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Education (Mr Shawn Huang Wei Zhong) (for the Minister for Education)
sentences.text: Based on the experiences of students in Full SBB pilot schools starting in 2020, Full SBB has enabled secondary school students to interact more regularly with a more diverse group of students.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Education (Mr Shawn Huang Wei Zhong) (for the Minister for Education)
sentences.text: Students spend around one-third of their curriculum time with peers of different academic profiles in mixed form classes during common subjects, such as Art, and Character and Citizenship Education.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Education (Mr Shawn Huang Wei Zhong) (for the Minister for Education)
sentences.text: Students in these pilot schools reported that they had a wider and more diverse network of friends, as well as more positive attitudes towards peers from different backgrounds.

sections.label: MOE monitoring Full SBB outcomes
sections.summary: MOE will keep monitoring Full SBB outcomes and provide necessary support to schools and teachers.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Education (Mr Shawn Huang Wei Zhong) (for the Minister for Education)
sentences.text: The Ministry of Education (MOE) will continue to monitor the outcomes from Full SBB and provide the necessary support to schools and teachers.

sections.label: Indicators of student networks
sections.summary: One indicator looks qualitatively at students' networks and friends, including whether Secondary 1 friendships persist in Secondary 2.

sentences.speaker: Mr Shawn Huang Wei Zhong
sentences.text: One of the indicators is looking qualitatively in terms of their networks and friends.

sentences.speaker: Mr Shawn Huang Wei Zhong
sentences.text: When they are in Secondary 1 in their mixed form groups, how are they interacting and how are they engaging one another?

sentences.speaker: Mr Shawn Huang Wei Zhong
sentences.text: And when they move to Secondary 2, do those friendships still persist inside and outside of their form classes?

sections.label: Long-term study of SBB
sections.summary: SBB has run only a couple of years, so it should be studied over the long term for longitudinal data.

sentences.speaker: Mr Shawn Huang Wei Zhong
sentences.text: SBB has only been for a couple of years.

sentences.speaker: Mr Shawn Huang Wei Zhong
sentences.text: So, this is something that we definitely want to put into it and study over the long term, and hopefully we get some longitudinal data from that.
